summary: Seventeen people were killed and 14 injured today in a car bomb blast in Damascus, with Damascus police cordoning off Mahlak Street near a security post on the road to the international airport and a shrine popular with Iranian, Iraqi and Lebanese pilgrims. Syrian television said the car was packed with 200kg of plastic explosives and that car bomb attacks are rare in this area. The blast is the first since the February assassination of Imad Moughniyah, the Hezbollah military commander; a senior security officer was also killed under mysterious circumstances at a beach resort near the port of Tartous, and several explosions have been blamed on Sunni Muslim militants opposed to Syria's secular government over the last few years.
